dominant_breach: charitable vehicles can receive immediate public tax subsidy while donors or narrow-control institutions retain advisory, timing, reputational, investment, or family-governance advantages that delay or redirect public benefit
fastest_washout: upfront deduction, advisory privileges, fund accumulation, minimum-payout loopholes, management fees, family involvement, and weak beneficiary standing wash out the public claim before charitable benefit is delivered

private_charitable_vehicle_public_subsid.note: Fail when tax expenditure creates immediate public cost while public benefit remains delayed, opaque, or donor-controlled.

tax_expenditure_vs_direct_spending_trans.note: Watch because deduction-based subsidy can bypass ordinary direct-spending visibility and prioritization.

direct: high-wealth households, donors, trustees, private intermediaries

public_balance_sheet_register.expected_loss: unknown; proxy evidence indicates material public revenue or transparency exposure
public_balance_sheet_register.stress_scenario: charitable vehicles can receive immediate public tax subsidy while donors or narrow-control institutions retain advisory, timing, reputational, investment, or family-governance advantages that delay or redirect public benefit
public_balance_sheet_register.loss_sharing: ordinary claimants face reduced public capacity or weaker enforcement while private vehicles retain control benefits

seniority_waterfall.stress_status: control rights remain highly senior unless law imposes disclosure, payout, or recapture
seniority_waterfall.notes: Donor-advised funds, private foundations, and public-subsidy timing control: private control can persist while public subsidy or opacity costs are socialized.

seniority_waterfall.claimant: trustee / sponsoring organization / private foundation board / intermediary
seniority_waterfall.stress_status: administrative control is often more durable than ordinary-claimant access
seniority_waterfall.notes: Intermediary control must be mapped separately from beneficial ownership and charitable purpose.

seniority_waterfall.claimant: ordinary public / intended charitable or tax beneficiaries
seniority_waterfall.stress_status: often politically or administratively junior unless payout, disclosure, and remedy are enforceable
seniority_waterfall.notes: Public benefit is not assumed from legal form; it must be claimable, timed, and measured.

case_notes: rev0325 promotes this from bounded active stress case to active public-subsidy timing-control case.
The case now treats aggregate DAF payout as context only; it does not prove timely public benefit without account- or vehicle-level evidence.
The minimum evidence package is a subsidy-timing waterfall from donor deduction to recipient benefit, including fees, dormant/low-payout balances, and public recapture or remedy.
reopening_triggers: new DAF annual report or IRS DAF statistics
evidence of dormant accounts, related-party fees, or family-control leakage
